svg.title: Fictional LNAV stepdown profile
svg.desc: Training-only schematic, not a navigation chart. Aircraft one mile before STEP. Minimum 1300 feet MSL before STEP; after STEP, MDA 900 feet MSL toward MAP. Advisory guidance cannot cancel the restriction.

g.text: TRAINING ONLY · FICTIONAL LNAV · NOT FOR NAVIGATION
Simplified profile · not to scale · altitudes MSL
Only the altitude relationship is shown; this is not a complete procedure.
